title: 池
teacherNotes: Release integration for L215. Latest origin/main is being advanced in playable order, with R011/R012 and all prior lessons integrated before this unit, so there are no unresolved provisional learned characters. Production owns the asset-complete lesson-local package; Release owns production JSON, planner, ledger, registry cleanup, final verify, merge, and deploy.

generationConstraints.allowedBoundary: latest origin/main production JSON through L214 plus current target from newChars
imageRules: Generate square image / 1:1 composition for each sentence.
Use L058 lesson images only as illustration style references; do not copy any L058 person, clothing, face, hair, or body shape.
Use protagonist family identity anchors from L154/L162/L163 when the sentence shows the protagonist girl or protagonist mother.
Swimming facility worker is an independent role, wearing simple facility work clothing or sports venue uniform, visually distinct from protagonist mother, school teacher, and the L058 adult woman.
No written text, numbers, signs, labels, zhuyin, watermarks, logos, brands, boat names, car plates, battery plus/minus symbols, pool names, direction labels, or readable marks.
Each image must clearly match its approved image notes and remain phone-readable in a square crop.

Human roles must be explicitly distinguished: protagonist little girl, protagonist mother, swimming facility worker, and distant passerby boat crew or sea worker must not share one face or be copied from L058.
audioRules: Use repo OpenAI audio flow only.
Generate G02 prefix/suffix and G05 wrong-option audio as standalone whole-text files from exact text.
Do not splice, cut, mute, patch, or extract production audio.

approvedSentences.imageNotes: 主角小女孩拿著不會發光或不會動的玩具，旁邊可看到打開的電池位置和沒有電的電池，但電池上不可有正負號、文字、數字、品牌或標籤。主角小女孩外觀依 L154/L162/L163 continuity；L058 只作畫風參考，不複製人物長相。

approvedSentences.text: 小魚在水池裡游來游去。
approvedSentences.spokenText: 小魚在水池裡游來游去
approvedSentences.imageNotes: 小魚在清楚的水池裡游來游去，畫面重點是水池、小魚和游動方向。可無人物。不可有文字、數字、水池標籤或水印。

approvedSentences.text: 不可以在魚池裡面游泳。
approvedSentences.spokenText: 不可以在魚池裡面游泳
approvedSentences.imageNotes: 主角媽媽提醒主角小女孩，不可以在魚池裡面游泳；畫面要清楚是魚池，有魚在池裡，主角小女孩站在池邊沒有下水。主角媽媽為白或米色上衣、寬藍褲、肩長深色髮；主角小女孩為粉紅外套、白上衣、藍裙、粉紅鞋、小粉紅髮夾。外觀依 L154/L162/L163 continuity；L058 只作畫風參考，不複製人物長相。不可有文字、數字、警告牌、標籤或水印。

approvedSentences.text: 游泳池再過去，有熱水池。
approvedSentences.spokenText: 游泳池再過去有熱水池
approvedSentences.imageNotes: 游泳場工作人員正在替主角媽媽和主角小女孩指路，表示游泳池再往前過去有熱水池；畫面可有兩個不同區域的水池，但不能有文字標示。游泳場工作人員是獨立角色，穿工作服或運動場館制服，必須和主角媽媽、學校老師、L058 成人女人外觀不同。主角媽媽為白或米色上衣、寬藍褲、肩長深色髮；主角小女孩為粉紅外套、白上衣、藍裙、粉紅鞋、小粉紅髮夾。不可有文字、數字、方向標籤、池名或水印。

approvedSentences.text: 風雨太大，海水進船裡了。
approvedSentences.spokenText: 風雨太大海水進船裡了
approvedSentences.imageNotes: 風雨很大，海水濺進或流進靠在岸邊的小船裡，畫面要有風雨、海水和船裡進水的情況，但不要呈現危險災難。可無人物；若有人物出現，只能是遠處路人船員或海上工作者，不可畫成主角家庭。不可有文字、數字、船名、標籤或水印。

G01.reason: 「游泳池」「熱水池」都是本課核心用法，目標字清楚。
